=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:650-660, 3724-3726 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `plan_base_ci_gate.sh` is missing from the "Stage workflow support files" list at plan.yml:650, so in consumer runs of the reusable workflow `[ -f scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh ]` is false and the red-base hold is skipped with no log line.
  WHY: In the 13 consumer repos, every clear plan on a red base is still auto-approved, even though changelog.d/stuck-backlog-phase2-red-base-hold.md:19 says the hold applies after the next `@stable` sync; tests miss this because `_run_step` copies the helper into `tmp/scripts`. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3724-3726 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The approval step sources `scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh` from the caller's checkout instead of a staged copy from `.codex-workflow-src`, while GH_TOKEN (GH_PAT) and AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET are in its env; the `! -L` check rejects only symlinks, not a regular file at that path.
  WHY: A consumer file at that path, whether unrelated, stale, or written by a consumer-side writer, is executed in the secret-bearing step and decides whether `/approved` is posted. Severity disagrees: sonnet and glm rated it NIT; gemini and luna rated MAJOR in the finding they combined with the staging gap. Highest is used.
- scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh:169-183 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The runs read uses `per_page=10` and keeps only `success`/`failure` conclusions, so if the 10 newest completed push runs are all cancelled or otherwise non-decisive, the helper reports status=pending reason=no_completed_run and allows approval.
  WHY: An older decisive failure tracked by a heal issue is never examined, so plans are approved on a red base during cancel-heavy incidents. Severity disagrees: gemini, minimax and luna rated MAJOR; sonnet (conf 2) and glm (conf 3) rated NIT and call it a bounded fail-open gap. Highest is used.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3186-3188, 3729-3737 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `PLAN_DEFAULT_BRANCH` comes from `github.event.repository.default_branch` and does not fall back to `steps.refctx.outputs.ref`, so the gate checks the default branch rather than the tracked base, which may be an orchestrator integration branch.
  WHY: A red integration branch with a green default branch is approved, and a green tracked branch is held when the default branch is red; heal issues targeting `orchestrator/project-*` can never match the target-line check (scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh:224-236). Dissent: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this finding because Phase 2 (docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:66) specifies the default branch.
- tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py:258-265 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: test_heal_issue_is_exempt sets `ai:workflow-heal`, so the step reaches the GraphQL heal-scope read (plan.yml:3574-3576), which GH_STUB does not implement; it then exits via the heal_scope_unverified hold (plan.yml:3667-3700) before the red-base block at plan.yml:3717.
  WHY: The test's assertions (`RED_BASE_APPROVAL_HOLD outcome=skipped` / `reason=heal_issue_exempt`) can never pass, so the heal-exemption contract is never checked. Dissent: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this finding because HEAL_PLAN_GRANT_BODY_EDIT_FIX_ENABLED=false keeps `plan_gate_heal` false (plan.yml:3563-3566).
- scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh:277-285 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hold-comment dedup trusts any `[bot]` login or OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR, not only the pipeline login that the plan specifies (docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:119).
  WHY: A collaborator or bot can post the `<!-- ai:red-base-approval-hold:v1 heal=<N> -->` marker, and the pipeline then skips its own hold explanation while the plan stays held. Both reviewers rated it NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes the rule mirrors the existing automation_path_plan_hold (plan.yml:3254-3258) and is not a regression.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If the plan's release path needs poller changes, implement only the plan.yml/helper side here and say so in the PR body." (linked issue #9682, Scope item 4)
  expected_change_site: PR description
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR body contains only the pre-push gate report and the Acceptance table, the deferral of the poller-side red check (`_plan_auto_approval_gate` in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, with `RED_BASE_HEALTH_CACHE`) appears only in changelog.d/stuck-backlog-phase2-red-base-hold.md(:20) and agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase2-red-base-hold.md, the standalone `auto_approve` arm (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26453-26478) has no red-base check so stall recovery can post `/approved` on a still-red base.
- requirement: "Tag the Telegram notice `INFO`, not CRITICAL." (docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:119, Phase 2 step 3; the plan wins per the issue)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml, step "Telegram plan notification", `elif [ "${PLAN_AUTO_APPROVE_HOLD_REASON:-}" = "base_ci_red" ]` branch (line 3792)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Line 3792 sends `tg_send_phase_tracked "${ISSUE_NUMBER}" "plan" "${MSG}" "DEBUG"`, the agents.d fragment and changelog document DEBUG, and under the default ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=WARNING the notice is suppressed (minimax rated it MAJOR, the others NIT).
- requirement: "The tests pass, and the changelog and agents.d fragments exist." (linked issue #9682, Acceptance criteria)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py (plus the failing test files in the pre-push gate report)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR's pre-push gate reports Status: fail, mode repair, "Failures caused by this change: 9", including tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py, tests/test_ai_labels.py, tests/test_ai_labels_retired.py, tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, tests/test_no_session_automation.py, tests/test_operator_step_issue.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_persist_orchestrator.py and tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py; the Acceptance table marks tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py (and per gemini tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py) "unmet". Gemini, luna and glm rated it BLOCKER. Sonnet (NIT, conf 2) calls it an unconfirmed signal: PR-head checks report failed_count 0 of 21, and the fragment headings exist in agents.md (lines 39 and 4197).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:650, 3724-3726 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: plan_base_ci_gate.sh is not on the "Stage workflow support files" required list (lines 650-661), so in a consumer run `scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh` exists only if the consumer ships it.
  WHY: In the 13 consumer repos (docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:44), the `[ -f ]` guard is false and the hold is skipped with no log line; tests miss this because `_run_step` copies HELPER into `tmp/scripts`. Fix: stage it, or use an optional loop like the render_prompt.py one at lines 690-700.
- scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh:red_base_approval_hold_check (`per_page=10`, jq `select((.conclusion // "") | IN("success", "failure"))`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Only the 10 newest completed push runs are examined; if all are non-decisive, the result is status=pending reason=no_completed_run and approval is allowed.
  WHY: This is a bounded fail-open gap; optionally count `timed_out` as a failure.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3724-3726 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The helper is sourced from the caller's working tree, not from the pinned workflow-source checkout (line 659); `! -L` does not reject a regular file.
  WHY: An unrelated or stale consumer file is sourced with GH_TOKEN/AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET in the env and decides whether `/approved` is posted.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "If the plan's release path needs poller changes, implement only the plan.yml/helper side here and say so in the PR body." | Expected change site: the PR description | Evidence of absence: The deferral is only in the changelog.d and agents.d fragments; the `auto_approve` arm (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26453-26478) calls `_plan_auto_approval_gate`, which has no red-base check, so stall recovery posts `/approved` on a red base. | SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Tag the Telegram notice `INFO`, not CRITICAL." (docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:119) | Expected change site: .github/workflows/plan.yml, "Telegram plan notification" base_ci_red branch (line 3792) | Evidence of absence: The branch sends "DEBUG"; the fragments document DEBUG. | SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The tests pass, and the changelog and agents.d fragments exist." | Expected change site: tests/test_plan_base_ci_gate.py | Evidence of absence: The pre-push gate reports fail and the acceptance table says "unmet", but PR-head checks show failed_count 0 of 21, the fragment headings exist in agents.md (lines 39, 4197), and no concrete failing assertion was found. This is an unconfirmed signal. | SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/plan.yml, about line 700: stage plan_base_ci_gate.sh with an optional loop modeled on render_prompt.py (est. 8 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/plan_base_ci_gate.sh hold_body plus plan.yml lines 3735 and 3791: reword "Stall recovery re-runs the approval checks later", because the poller gate has no red-base check (est. 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- Pass-1 items checked and not confirmed (3 related items): (a) default-branch vs refctx contradicts the plan (docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:66); (b) test_heal_issue_is_exempt passes because HEAL_PLAN_GRANT_BODY_EDIT_FIX_ENABLED=false keeps `plan_gate_heal` false (plan.yml:3563-3566); (c) the hold-comment dedup trust rule mirrors automation_path_plan_hold (plan.yml:3254-3258), so it is not a regression.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: The helper examines only the 10 newest completed runs and ignores conclusions other than `success`/`failure`.
  WHY: If those runs are non-decisive, it reports `pending` and allows approval even when the latest decisive run was a tracked failure.
